series.name: SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV / 4KW-24V Twin
series.notes: Official SIMRON manual: fault + warning tables (includes fault 04/59 and warnings 15/16/EQ not on SIMREX).

title.en: Fan is locked when inverter is off
title.ur: inverter band hone par Pankha band

meaning.en: Fan locked while inverter is OFF (fault table context).
meaning.ur: inverter off hone par Pankha band.

causes.en: Fan seized or obstructed
causes.ur: Pankha atka

causes.en: Fan connector loose or supply wire broken.
causes.ur: Fan ka connection dheela ya supply wire tooti hui hai.

causes.en: Dust or a foreign object blocking the fan blades.
causes.ur: Dhool ya koi cheez pankha ki blades rok rahi hai.

solutions.en: Switch off AC input and PV, open the DC breaker and wait 5 minutes; open the cover and look for dust or an object blocking the fan.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV band karein, DC breaker kholein aur 5 minute intezar karein; cover khol kar dekhein ke dhool ya koi cheez pankha rok rahi hai.

solutions.en: With power isolated, spin the fan by hand — it must turn freely; check the fan plug on the board for a loose fit or burn marks.
solutions.ur: Power band hone ke baad pankha haath se ghuma kar dekhein — azaadi se ghumna chahiye; board par fan ka plug dheela ya jale hue nishan to nahin, yeh check karein.

solutions.en: If the fan is stuck or does not run, replace it with the same size fan and restart the unit to retest.
solutions.ur: Agar pankha phans gaya hai ya chal nahin raha, to usi size ka naya fan lagayein aur unit restart kar ke dobara test karein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

notes.en: Warning 01 is fan locked when inverter is ON.
notes.ur: Warning 01 tab fan locked hai jab inverter ON ho.

causes.en: Poor airflow / high ambient
causes.ur: hawa kam darja hararat zyada

causes.en: Cooling fan not running or running too slow.
causes.ur: Cooling fan chal nahin raha ya bohat dheere chal raha hai.

causes.en: Filters and heat sink clogged with dust.
causes.ur: Filters aur heat sink dhool se band hue hue hain.

solutions.en: Switch off AC input and PV and let the unit cool for 10–15 minutes; clear blocked vents and clean dust from filters and heat sinks.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV band kar ke unit ko 10-15 minute thanda hone dein; band vents kholein aur filters aur heat sinks se dhool saaf karein.

solutions.en: Restart with a lighter load and listen that the cooling fan runs; also check the room ambient is not too hot.
solutions.ur: Halka load kar ke restart karein aur sun kar dekhein ke cooling fan chal raha hai; kamre ka temperature bhi zyada to nahin, yeh check karein.

solutions.en: If the trip returns with clear airflow, the fan or temperature sensor is faulty — have the board checked at the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Hawa saaf hone ke baad bhi trip wapas aaye, to pankha ya temperature sensor kharab hai — board ko repair centre se check karwayein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

causes.en: Wrong battery spec/quantity
causes.ur: ghalat battery

causes.en: Charger full-charge voltage set too high.
causes.ur: Charger ka full-charge voltage bohat zyada set hai.

causes.en: Weak battery cell holding the voltage high.
causes.ur: Kamzor battery cell voltage ko zyada rakhta hai.

solutions.en: Switch off AC input and PV, then measure the battery voltage with a meter and compare it with the battery specification.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV band kar ke meter se battery voltage naapein aur battery specification se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check the number of battery units and the charger full-charge setting; correct the setting or quantity if they are wrong.
solutions.ur: Battery units ki tadad aur charger ka full-charge setting check karein; setting ya tadad ghalat ho to theek karein.

solutions.en: If the voltage is still too high with correct settings, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Sahi settings ke baad bhi voltage zyada rahe, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

meaning.en: Battery voltage too low (fault). SIMREX has no fault 04.

causes.en: Deep discharge, weak battery
causes.ur: battery khaali/kamzor

causes.en: Battery left discharged for a long time.
causes.ur: Battery lambi arse se khali discharge ho gayi thi.

causes.en: Loose battery cable or corroded terminal.
causes.ur: Battery cable dheeli hai ya terminal par zang hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV, then measure the battery voltage with a multimeter and recharge it before further testing.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV alag kar ke multimeter se battery voltage naapein aur mazeed testing se pehle battery charge karein.

solutions.en: Check battery cables, terminals and fuse for looseness, corrosion or a blown fuse; tighten or replace as needed.
solutions.ur: Battery cables, terminals aur fuse check karein ke dheela, zang ya uda hua fuse to nahin; zaroorat ho to tight ya badal dein.

solutions.en: Load-test the battery — if the voltage collapses under load, replace the battery and restart the unit.
solutions.ur: Battery ka load test karein — load par voltage gir jaye to battery badal kar unit restart karein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

notes.en: Unique to SIMRON fault table vs SIMREX.
notes.ur: SIMREX ke muqable yeh sirf SIMRON fault table mein hai.

causes.en: Wiring fault / appliance short
causes.ur: Wiring ya AC lines mein short

causes.en: Damaged appliance creating the short on the output.
causes.ur: Kharab appliance output par short bana raha hai.

causes.en: Moisture or a loose joint in the output wiring.
causes.ur: Output wiring mein pani (moisture) ya dheela joint hai.

solutions.en: Stop the unit and isolate AC input and PV at once — never probe a short while the output is live.
solutions.ur: Unit rok dein aur foran AC input aur PV alag karein — output chalte hue short par kabhi probe na karein.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, check the output wiring and each appliance for burn marks or wet joints; unplug the suspect load.
solutions.ur: Supply band kar ke output wiring aur har appliance check karein ke jale hue nishan ya geele joints to nahin; shak wala load plug se nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Repair the wiring or remove the faulty appliance, then restart; if the code returns, the output stage needs service.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek karein ya kharab appliance hatayein, phir restart karein; code wapas aaye to output stage ki service zaroori hai.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

meaning.en: Output voltage too high (SIMRON table). Troubleshooting groups 06/58 as <190 or >260Vac.
meaning.ur: output voltage bohat zyada (had se bahar)

causes.en: Overload/AVR or stage fault
causes.ur: load ya output stage kharabi

causes.en: Heavy load pushing the output stage beyond its range.
causes.ur: Bhari load output stage ko uski range se bahar push kar raha hai.

causes.en: Loose output connection or a bad relay contact.
causes.ur: Output connection dheela hai ya relay contact kharab hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load and restart, then measure the AC output with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Load kam kar ke restart karein, phir multimeter se AC output naapein.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, check the output terminals and relay contacts for looseness or burn marks.
solutions.ur: Supply alag kar ke output terminals aur relay contacts check karein ke dheela ya jale hue nishan to nahin.

solutions.en: If the output is still too high with a light load, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Halke load par bhi output zyada rahe, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

notes.en: Conflicts with SIMREX fault 06 Output voltage is abnormal.
notes.ur: Isay SIMREX fault 06 'Output voltage is abnormal' se conflict hai.

causes.en: Load too high
causes.ur: load zyada

causes.en: Motor or pump start current too high.
causes.ur: Motor ya pump ka start current bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Too many appliances on at the same time.
causes.ur: Ek sath bohat sare appliances chalu karne se load zyada ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Switch off some equipment so the load drops below the inverter rating, then restart the unit.
solutions.ur: Kuch equipment band kar dein taake load inverter rating se neeche aa jaye, phir unit restart karein.

solutions.en: Check the load with a clamp meter if available — motors and pumps can draw more than their rated current.
solutions.ur: Agar clamp meter ho to load check karein — motors aur pump apne rated current se zyada kha sakte hain.

solutions.en: Restart only after reducing the load; if it trips again, spread the load or have the unit checked.
solutions.ur: Load kam karne ke baad hi restart karein; phir trip ho to load baant dein ya unit check karwayein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

causes.en: Internal components failed
causes.ur: andaruni kharabi

causes.en: Regenerative energy raising the DC bus.
causes.ur: Regenerative energy DC bus ko barha raha hai.

causes.en: DC bus capacitor or bleed resistor failed.
causes.ur: DC bus capacitor ya bleed resistor kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Power off, switch off AC input and PV and wait 5 minutes; do not probe the DC bus — capacitors hold dangerous voltage.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, AC input aur PV off kar ke 5 minute intezar karein; DC bus par probe na rakhein — capacitors mein khatarnak voltage reh jata hai.

solutions.en: Open the cover with supply isolated and look for burnt parts, bulged capacitors or loose connections.
solutions.ur: Supply band kar ke cover kholein aur jalay hue parts, phoolay hue capacitors ya dheele connections dekhein.

solutions.en: If the fault repeats after restart, the power stage needs repair — send the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Restart ke baad bhi fault dobara aaye, to power stage ki repair zaroori hai — unit ko repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

causes.en: Internal components failed
causes.ur: andaruni kharabi

causes.en: DC bus did not charge during the soft-start.
causes.ur: Soft-start ke dauran DC bus charge nahin hua.

causes.en: Soft-start relay or resistor circuit fault.
causes.ur: Soft-start relay ya resistor circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV, wait 5 minutes, then restart once and watch whether the code returns.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV alag kar ke 5 minute ruk kar ek baar restart karein aur dekhein ke code wapas aata hai ya nahin.

solutions.en: Check the DC input cable and main fuse for looseness or damage; do not probe the high-voltage bus yourself.
solutions.ur: DC input cable aur main fuse check karein ke dheela ya kharab to nahin; high-voltage bus par khud probe na karein.

solutions.en: If the soft-start fails again, the DC/DC or bus stage has failed — send the unit for board repair.
solutions.ur: Agar soft-start phir bhi fail ho, to DC/DC ya bus stage kharab ho gaya hai — unit ko board repair ke liye bhej dein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

causes.en: PV array oversize / fault
causes.ur: PV array bara ya kharab ho.

causes.en: Parallel strings more than the unit rating.
causes.ur: Parallel strings unit rating se zyada hain.

causes.en: Damaged panel leaking current in the array.
causes.ur: Kharab panel array mein current chhoda raha hai.

solutions.en: Turn off the PV DC isolator and check the array strings for damaged panels, water or loose connectors.
solutions.ur: PV DC isolator band kar ke array strings check karein ke panels kharab, paani ya connectors dheele to nahin.

solutions.en: Confirm the array is within the unit rating; reduce parallel strings if it is oversized, then restart.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke array unit rating ke andar hai; zyada bada ho to parallel strings kam kar ke restart karein.

solutions.en: If the fault returns with a correct array, have the DC input stage checked at the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Sahi array ke sath bhi fault wapas aaye, to DC input stage ko repair centre se check karwayein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

causes.en: Surge or excessive load
causes.ur: Surge ya zyada load

causes.en: Motor or pump inrush current at start-up.
causes.ur: Motor ya pump ka start par inrush current.

causes.en: Short or insulation fault on the output wiring.
causes.ur: Output wiring par short ya insulation fault.

solutions.en: Switch off heavy loads such as motors and pumps, restart the unit and see if it runs on a light load.
solutions.ur: Motor aur pump jaisi bhari load band kar dein, unit restart karein aur dekhein ke halke load par chal raha hai.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, check the output and battery wiring for shorts, loose terminals or burnt cables.
solutions.ur: Supply band kar ke output aur battery wiring check karein ke short, dheele terminals ya jali hui cables to nahin.

solutions.en: If the error returns even on a light load, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Halke load par bhi error wapas aa jaye, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

notes.en: SIMREX uses Over current or surge.
notes.ur: SIMREX mein 'Over current or surge' use hota hai.

causes.en: Weak battery / DC path
causes.ur: kamzor battery

causes.en: Battery discharged or one weak cell.
causes.ur: Battery discharge hai ya koi cell kamzor hai.

causes.en: Blown fuse or loose DC cable.
causes.ur: Fuse uda hua hai ya DC cable dheeli hai.

solutions.en: Measure the battery voltage under load with a multimeter — a weak battery is the usual cause.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se load par battery voltage naapein — kamzor battery aam wajah hoti hai.

solutions.en: Isolate supply and check DC cables, fuse and connections for looseness, corrosion or a blown fuse.
solutions.ur: Supply alag kar ke DC cables, fuse aur connections check karein ke dheela, zang ya uda hua fuse to nahin.

solutions.en: Charge or replace the battery and restart; if the trip repeats, send the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Battery charge ya replace kar ke restart karein; trip dobara aaye to unit ko repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

causes.en: Internal components failed
causes.ur: andaruni kharabi

causes.en: DC bus did not reach the start level.
causes.ur: DC bus start level tak nahin pahuncha.

causes.en: Gate drive fault in the inverter stage.
causes.ur: Inverter stage mein gate drive fault hai.

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC input and PV and wait 5 minutes before opening the unit for a visual check.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, AC input aur PV alag kar ke 5 minute intezar karein, phir cover khol kar nazar se check karein.

solutions.en: Restart once after cooling; if the same code appears, the inverter stage failed to start.
solutions.ur: Thanda hone ke baad ek baar restart karein; agar wohi code aaya to inverter stage start nahin hua.

solutions.en: Do not keep cycling power — return the unit to the repair centre for board repair.
solutions.ur: Bar bar power on-off na karein — unit ko board repair ke liye repair centre le jayein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

title.en: Over DC voltage in AC output

meaning.en: DC component on AC output (also described as output unbalanced in troubleshooting).

causes.en: Output stage fault
causes.ur: output stage kharabi

causes.en: One output leg or relay contact has high resistance.
causes.ur: Kisi ek output leg ya relay contact par zyada resistance hai.

causes.en: Output filter capacitor degraded.
causes.ur: Output filter capacitor kamzor ho gaya.

solutions.en: Reduce the load, restart and measure the AC output with a multimeter to confirm the DC component or unbalance.
solutions.ur: Load kam kar ke restart karein aur multimeter se AC output naapein ke DC component ya unbalance kitna hai.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, check the output wiring and relay contacts for looseness or burn marks.
solutions.ur: Supply alag kar ke output wiring aur relay contacts check karein ke dheela ya jale hue nishan to nahin.

solutions.en: If it stays abnormal even at no load, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Bina load ke bhi abnormal rahe, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

causes.en: Sensor/hardware failure
causes.ur: sensor kharabi

causes.en: Current sensor connector loose or damaged.
causes.ur: Current sensor ka connection dheela ya kharab hai.

causes.en: Main board sensing circuit fault.
causes.ur: Main board ki sensing circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV, wait 5 minutes, then restart once to see whether the code clears.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV alag kar ke 5 minute ruk kar ek baar restart karein aur dekhein ke code hat jata hai ya nahin.

solutions.en: Open the unit with power isolated and check that the current sensor (CT/shunt) connector is seated and undamaged.
solutions.ur: Power band kar ke unit kholein aur check karein ke current sensor (CT/shunt) ka connector theek laga hai ya kharab to nahin.

solutions.en: The sensor or board circuit has failed — send the unit to the repair centre for replacement.
solutions.ur: Sensor ya board circuit kharab ho gaya hai — unit ko replacement ke liye repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

meaning.en: Output voltage too low (grouped with 06: <190Vac or >260Vac).

causes.en: Heavy load / weak battery / stage fault
causes.ur: zyada load ya kamzor battery

causes.en: Long output cable causing voltage drop.
causes.ur: Lambi output cable voltage drop de rahi hai.

causes.en: Weak battery under load.
causes.ur: Load par battery kamzor hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load and restart, then measure the AC output with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Load kam kar ke restart karein, phir multimeter se AC output naapein.

solutions.en: Check the battery voltage under load and the output wiring for loose joints — both pull the output down.
solutions.ur: Load par battery voltage aur output wiring ke dheele joints check karein — dono output ko neeche kheenchte hain.

solutions.en: If the voltage is still low, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage phir bhi kam rahe, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual

title.en: PV voltage is beyond the acceptable range
title.ur: PV voltage qubool had se bahar

meaning.en: PV voltage outside acceptable range (SIMRON-only fault vs SIMREX).
meaning.ur: PV voltage qubool had se bahar

causes.en: Too many panels in series for MPPT window
causes.ur: series main zyada panel

causes.en: Cold weather pushed the string voltage up.
causes.ur: Sardi ne string voltage ko upar kar diya.

causes.en: Wrong array specification chosen for this model.
causes.ur: Is model ke liye ghalat array specification choose ki gayi.

solutions.en: Switch off the PV DC isolator and measure the string voltage with a meter against the unit rating.
solutions.ur: PV DC isolator band kar ke meter se string voltage naapein aur unit rating se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of PV modules in series so the voltage falls inside the MPPT window, then reconnect.
solutions.ur: Voltage ko MPPT window ke andar lane ke liye series mein PV modules ki tadad kam karein, phir dobara connect karein.

solutions.en: Check panels and connectors for damage and replace what is faulty before restarting.
solutions.ur: Panels aur connectors mein kharabi check karein aur restart se pehle jo kharab ho use badal dein.

source.title: SIMTEK SIMRON PV5000-VM-IV 4K Twin User Manual
